announcement.quote: MVC CAPITAL, INC. TO MERGE WITH BARINGS BDC, INC. Combined Company To Be Managed by Barings LLC

outcome_evidence.quote: BARINGS BDC, INC. COMPLETES MERGER WITH MVC CAPITAL, INC. CHARLOTTE, N.C., December 23, 2020 - Barings BDC, Inc. (NYSE: BBDC) ("Barings BDC") announced today the closing of the previously announced merger with MVC Capital, Inc. ("MVC Capital").

deals.notes: Barings BDC is shown as NYSE: BBDC. No excerpt prints a ticker or exchange for MVC's own shares (only its 6.25% Senior Notes due 2022 are said to be delisted from NYSE), so both_listed is null. The merger is a single pair; no other target is named for this proposal in the excerpts.

announcement.quote: SIERRA INCOME CORPORATION TO MERGE WITH BARINGS BDC, INC. AND COMBINED COMPANY TO BE MANAGED BY BARINGS LLC

outcome_evidence.quote: BARINGS BDC, INC. COMPLETES MERGER WITH SIERRA INCOME CORPORATION CHARLOTTE, N.C., February 25, 2022 - Barings BDC, Inc. (NYSE: BBDC) (“Barings BDC”) announced today the closing of the previously announced merger with Sierra Income Corporation (“Sierra”).

deals.notes: Barings BDC is shown as NYSE: BBDC. No excerpt states that Sierra's shares trade on an exchange, so both_listed is null. The 8-K filed 2022-02-25 (0001140361-22-006820) reports the special meeting vote; the completion press release is exhibit 99.1 of the 8-K filed 2022-03-03 (event date 2022-02-25).

problems: No failed deal in this episode: both proposals (MVC Capital 2020, Sierra Income 2021) are shown completed. Listing status of the targets is not stated in the excerpts.
